You are a mathematics expert solving competition-level problems. 
Solve the problem step by step, showing your work clearly.
At the end, provide your final answer in the format:
Answer: <your_answer>

Where <your_answer> is the numerical or mathematical answer to the problem.

How many unoccupied beds are in the hospital after 2 weeks? The hospital has a capacity of 1000 beds. One-fifth of the hospital beds are occupied. Due to the coronavirus outbreak, 50 patients are admitted into the hospital each day. The time period is 2 weeks. Each admitted patient occupies a hospital bed for exactly one day. The hospital currently has 420 beds available for coronavirus patients. One week contains 7 days.
